plantuml.boundary: a diagram first renders that day (view) or first renders after a change that day (edit), a valid export is initiated, or workspace import completes

base64-tools.boundary: at least one output is produced

compress-image.boundary: a Compress click readies at least one validated lossless, lossy or resized image

tlv-viewer.boundary: the user's own input parses and results render

qr-tools.boundary: download is initiated from valid rendered content

querify.boundary: at least one file generates successfully

redis-cache.boundary: key search or value inspection completes, or one or more keys are removed

kafka.boundary: one or more Kafka messages are confirmed delivered

run-batch.boundary: Jenkins reports the batch run complete

velocity-template.boundary: clipboard write, explicit valid local render, 2xx validator response, SQL import or context sync succeeds

merge-sql.boundary: SQL result is generated and saved

lockey-update.boundary: validated INSERT SQL is copied or downloaded

master-lockey.boundary: a typed search with results stays on screen for 1.5s or is copied, or a Confluence page or bulk search returns lockeys
